name: Health Scheduler
summary: Device and runtime health monitoring, restart-pressure scoring, maintenance scheduling and action decisions for DeepSeek Harness.
summary_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的设备与运行时健康监控、重启压力评分、维护调度与动作决策。

does: score restart pressure 0-100 across six dimensions
decide NO_ACTION / THROTTLE / PAUSE_NEW_WORK / REQUEST_APP_RESTART / REQUEST_SYSTEM_REBOOT
gate restart requests on the maintenance window and the safe point
audit every applied action with its drivers and reason codes
doesNot: modify task queues or task state
decide when a restart is safe on its own

degradation.restartPluginAbsent: monitoring and mitigation continue; restart requests are reported as capability unavailable
degradation.workerControlAbsent: monitoring continues; THROTTLE and PAUSE_NEW_WORK are recorded but not applied
degradation.providerFailure: the provider backs off exponentially; every other provider keeps sampling
degradation.telemetryAbsent: the affected dimension is reported as unknown and its weight is redistributed; unknown is never scored as healthy
